items.t: MARA Holdings Jumps 11% on $500 Million Buyback, Riot Platforms Climbs 2% on Jefferies Upgrade Despite Bitcoin’s Drop; Core Scientific Edges Higher
items.sum: Bitcoin is sliding and Fed hike odds are climbing, yet three miners are rallying anyway. One of them posted a huge earnings beat that hides a much weaker quarter underneath, and the real test comes before year end.
